architecture_decisions.rationale: Fix a bug where apply_async(ignore_result=False) on a task with ignore_result=True would fail to return results. Introduce get_actual_ignore_result for proper priority lookup.

tickets.title: Fix: prioritize request ignore_result over task definition
tickets.description: Fix a bug where apply_async(ignore_result=False) on a task with ignore_result=True would fail to return results. Introduce get_actual_ignore_result for proper priority lookup.

implementation_summary: This change implements 'Fix: prioritize request ignore_result over task definition' for celery. Fix a bug where apply_async(ignore_result=False) on a task with ignore_result=True would fail to return results. Introduce get_actual_ignore_result for proper priority lookup. Modified files: celery/app/trace.py, celery/worker/request.py, docs/userguide/tasks.rst, t/unit/tasks/test_trace.py, t/unit/worker/test_request.py.
